title: Zesty Smoky Slovakian Pork Skewers
description: A fresh and flavorful Slovakian dish featuring marinated pork, perfect for a brunch gathering, with a lacquer glaze and raw friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together kosher salt, brown sugar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper.
Add the pork pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the marinated pork onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with lacquer glaze and olive oil.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pork is cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together apple cider vinegar and a pinch of kosher salt.
Brush the skewers with the vinegar mixture during the last minute of grilling.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
